title: Ball-measure identity extends from μ-null-sphere radii to all radii (Simon 7.3.1 proof, after display (4))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)) with μ(B_r(0)) < ∞ for every r > 0, and let c ∈ [0, ∞] with c ≠ ∞. Suppose μ(B_ρ(0)) = c·ofReal(ρⁿ) for every ρ > 0 such that μ(sphere(0, ρ)) = 0, where sphere(0, ρ) = {y : |y| = ρ}. Then μ(B_ρ(0)) = c·ofReal(ρⁿ) for every ρ > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ ∞ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (ball 0 r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (sphere 0 ρ) = 0 → μ (ball 0 ρ) = c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (ball 0 ρ) = c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
